headline: 先猜落脚点，再只扫那一小块地形
title_en: Watch Your Step: Foothold Prediction for Humanoid Locomotion
tagline_en: ETH Zurich's code trains a humanoid to predict its next two footholds, then look only at the terrain around them.
summary_md:
**What it is.** This is the training and evaluation code for *Watch Your Step: Anticipated Perception for Humanoid Locomotion* by Matthias Heyrman, Chenhao Li, Ioannis Dadiotis, and Marco Hutter at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab and ETH AI Center. The system trains a Unitree G1 humanoid in Isaac Lab with two parts learned together: a foothold prediction model (FPM) that guesses the next two footholds from proprioception and the velocity command, and a locomotion policy that reads the elevation map only in 7x7 patches around those predicted footholds.

**Why it matters.** Most perceptive locomotion policies look at a wide swath of terrain every step, which costs compute and can be noisy. This work asks the robot to look where it is about to step instead. The policy transfers zero-shot to the real robot, per the project page.

**Can you try it without a robot?** The repo needs Isaac Sim 5.1, Isaac Lab 2.3.0, and rsl-rl-lib 3.3.0, so it won't run on a typical Mac. The project page links a video and a version of the policy that runs in the browser, though the repo itself does not include a web demo, so check the project page for what is actually live.

top.title: nvidia/Alpamayo2-Edge
top.one_liner: 英伟达2B参数的车载模型，看路况直接输出驾驶轨迹和推理说明。
top.one_liner_en: NVIDIA's 2B-parameter in-car model turns camera views into driving trajectories plus explanations.
top.how_to_try: 需真实多相机驾驶数据和DRIVE Thor级算力；Mac上只能读代码、看仓库附带的推理样例。
top.how_to_try_en: Needs multi-camera driving data and DRIVE Thor-class compute; on a Mac you can only read the repo and sample inference scripts.
top.reason: 模型有特色（推理+轨迹，体积小），开源程度尚可，但对没有硬件的新人几乎无法上手，学习价值主要停留在代码阅读。
red_flags: 输入要求六个相机、22帧图像和20个历史位姿，单机几乎无法复现

top.title: CuboiLeo/SuperMimic-Reproduced
top.one_liner: 一个人独立复现了人形机器人全身控制论文，用可微世界模型让 Unitree G1 在仿真里模仿各种动作。
top.one_liner_en: A solo from-scratch reproduction of a humanoid whole-body control paper using a differentiable world model on Unitree G1 in simulation.
top.how_to_try: 训练需 4 张 RTX 5090，Mac 跑不动训练；可用 mjlab 在 MuJoCo 里加载官方 checkpoint 看回放，或先看作者仓库的展示视频。
top.how_to_try_en: Training needs 4x RTX 5090, impossible on a Mac. Only load the released checkpoint in mjlab/MuJoCo to replay, or watch the demo videos.
top.reason: 高质量独立复现，诚实报告失败与观测缺陷，学习价值高；但训练门槛极高，无硬件新人只能看视频和回放。
red_flags: 核心训练需多张顶级 GPU，单机 Mac 无法复现
仅是他人复现记录、官方代码已发布，该仓库不再维护
